description: Same formula as https://winbackhq.com/tools/win-back-revenue-calculator/ : people lost per segment times a return rate, times price, over up to 6 months, minus the 15% fee. Default return rates: cancelled 20% (RevenueCat SOSA 2026 monthly reactivation within a year, a reference not a forecast), billing failed 10% (assumption), trial expired 5% (assumption).

billing_failed.description: Subscribers lost to failed payments this month

months_paid.description: Months a returner pays, 1 to 6 (default 6, an upper bound)

trial_expired.description: Trials that ended unpaid this month
